answer: Duplicate or fabricated plots are caught by cross-referencing satellite imagery, so a sybil farm must acquire real distinct land and lock real capital per identity. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to a verifiable physical landmark, where each agent must register a unique juniper grove plot along a mapped ridge and post a bond proportional to plot value. The marginal cost of a fake plume of identities then exceeds the reward from any single epoch, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
